title: Canonical operations and adjunction-normalized comparisons on integral coefficient systems
statement: For a prime $\ell$ and finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], on the small pro-etale sites of schemes [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], use the strict coefficient-system category and its reduction/limit calculus [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Define the simultaneous operation package to retain the actual sequence-site exact inverse image and its universal total right-derived direct image, with the derived adjunction and normalized evaluation units, counits and quotient transitions [lem-pur-coefficient-system-derived-comparison]. Include exact termwise open extension with its ordinary adjunction, and finite evaluation fixed by the inverse-image transpose [lem-sf-open-tensor-normalization]. Its helper interfaces specify section-normalized pullback/direct-image compositors, open base-change and tensor comparisons, clopen comparison, and the general proper/open restriction composite through the clopen lift [lem-cbc-strict-tower-proper-open-calculus]. The actual completed-coefficient categories [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data] and canonical K-flat pullback/tensor models [def-pur-completed-pullback-tensor-comparison] fix its realization and projection helpers.
